ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 12

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 5

3. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

4. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 13

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

6. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 5
   C. 25
   D. 11

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

8. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 3
   C. 28
   D. 11

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 17
   C. 27
   D. 31

10. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 0
   C. 65
   D. 16

11. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 48
   C. 14
   D. 49

12. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
